RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Storm Spin
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Start spinning. The first 3 seconds are free; later pulses spend 8 shield every 0.5 seconds, up to 12 seconds total. Movement does not interrupt it; standing still grows its radius.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Wind-down Strike
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Manually end the spin and strike one enemy. Damage increases with completed pulses, up to 44 base ability damage.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Empty the Magazine
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Spend all prismatic rounds for 7 base ability damage each. Requires a ranged weapon. Autocast waits for a full magazine.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Deploy Node
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Choose an empty cell for a stationary projection, or choose your own summon as a relay. One designated relay per owner; projections last 30 seconds.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Resonance Pulse
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Cast a pulse from a linked relay or yourself for 14 base ability damage. The first pulse within 6 seconds of recalling a node deals 21 instead.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Recall Node
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Manually consume the designated summon, gain 16 shield, reset Resonance Pulse cooldown and strengthen its next cast within 6 seconds. Recall can be used once per 6 seconds, regardless of haste or cooldown refunds.
